nina-cs: Heads-up: HelioMaps renewal in 10 days. they opened a ticket asking for SLO evidence for last week (uptime + latency) and a provisional credit number. can we assemble a 1-page bundle by EOD?
sam-ops: On it. quick check shows org uptime 99.55% for 2025-12-01..2025-12-07. notable spike in p95 at 2025-12-03 09:11-09:23 UTC. linking quick chart: https://console.redwood.ai/metrics/heliomaps/slo
vik-sre: I see a canary swap at 09:05, then a routing churn at 09:12. logs indicate increased retry rates and a couple of worker OOMs. short root-cause: canary variant had higher memory footprint; fallback routing overloaded smaller instances.
sam-ops: I'll generate the bundle with metrics.csv, latency_table.csv, traces.txt and credit_calc.md. command: run-slo-bundle --acct heliomaps --from 2025-12-01 --to 2025-12-07 --out heliomaps-bundle-1757770123.zip. ETA ~15m.
deploy-bot: Deploy 2025-12-03_09:05:12 by @release-ci succeeded: canary->primary (route: heliomaps-prod) :rocket:
vik-sre: Suggested mitigations to include in incident blurb: revert canary, increase kv cache, add 2-instance autoscale headroom. Also recommend adding a preflight synthetic test for memory regressions.
finance-bot: provisional credit calc: inputs: uptime shortfall 0.45%, affected request volume 9.4k, applied ratecard -> provisional credit = "$1,200". preliminary, requires sales/finance approval.
nina-cs: Good. I'll draft the customer note: short apology, attach bundle, state provisional credit, offer 20-min walkthrough. tagging @sales-ops for signoff. please paste trace ids and p50/p95 table here when done.
sam-ops: bundle uploaded: https://s3.redwood.ai/heliomaps/evidence/1757770123-helio.zip (metrics.csv, latency_table.csv, traces.txt, credit_calc.md). p50/p95 table and top 5 trace ids inside the bundle.
nina-cs: thanks all. i'll route to sales and legal. flagging renewal risk 30% until walkthrough completed. :warning:
